mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from mst_equip_hier h left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = h.node_id where h.node_id = #{nodeId} and h.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and h.use_yn = 'Y' and h.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') and coalesce(a.stock_yn, 'Y') = 'Y')
mapper.insert: insert into wms_loc_check (comp_cd, plant_cd, node_id, check_date, worker_id, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{nodeId}, #{checkDate}, #{workerId}, #{by}, #{by}) on conflict (comp_cd, node_id, check_date) do nothing
mapper.sql: c.check_id, c.plant_cd, c.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(c.node_id) as path, c.check_date, c.status, c.worker_id, c.ok_cnt, c.misplaced_cnt, c.missing_cnt, c.unknown_cnt, c.accurate_yn, c.done_at, c.done_by, c.created_at, c.created_by, (select count(*) from wms_loc_check_line l where l.check_id = c.check_id) as line_cnt, (select count(*) from wms_loc_check_line l where l.check_id = c.check_id and l.result <> 'OK' and l.review_action is null) as open_cnt
mapper.select: select from wms_loc_check c join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = c.node_id where c.node_id = #{nodeId} and c.check_date = #{checkDate} for update of c
select from wms_loc_check c join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = c.node_id where c.check_id = #{id} for update of c
mapper.sql:
l.line_id, l.check_id, l.scan_code, l.scan_type, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, l.lot_id, m.lot_no, l.result, l.reason_cd,
(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(b.e || jsonb_build_object('usage', a.loc_usage) order by b.ord), '[]'::jsonb)::text from jsonb_array_elements(l.book) with ordinality b(e, ord) left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = (b.e->>'nodeId')::bigint) as book_json, l.scanned_at, l.worker_id, l.client_req_id, l.recorded_at, l.recorded_by, l.review_action, l.review_reason, l.reviewed_at, l.reviewed_by, l.move_grp_id
mapper.select: select from wms_loc_check_line l left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master m on m.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.check_id = #{checkId} order by l.line_id
select from wms_loc_check_line l left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master m on m.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.line_id = #{lineId}
select line_id from wms_loc_check_line where line_id = #{lineId} for update
select line_id from wms_loc_check_line where client_req_id = #{req}
select line_id from wms_loc_check_line where check_id = #{checkId} and result <> 'MISSING' and item_id = #{itemId} and lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint order by line_id limit 1
select lot_ctrl_yn from mst_item where item_id = #{itemId}

select s.node_id, wms_node_path(s.node_id) as path, s.stock_status as status, s.qty from inv_stock s where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.lot_id is not distinct from #{lotId}::bigint and s.qty > 0 order by s.qty desc, s.node_id, s.stock_status limit 50

select s.item_id, s.lot_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('nodeId', s.node_id, 'path', wms_node_path(s.node_id), 'status', s.stock_status, 'qty', trim_scale(s.qty)::text) order by s.stock_status)::text as book_json from inv_stock s where s.node_id = #{nodeId} and s.qty > 0 and not exists (select 1 from wms_loc_check_line l where l.check_id = #{checkId} and l.result <> 'MISSING' and l.item_id = s.item_id and l.lot_id is not distinct from s.lot_id) group by s.item_id, s.lot_id order by s.item_id, s.lot_id nulls first
mapper.insert: insert into wms_loc_check_line (comp_cd, check_id, scan_code, scan_type, item_id, lot_id, result, reason_cd, book, scanned_at, worker_id, client_req_id, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{r.checkId}, #{r.scanCode}, #{r.scanType}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.lotId}, #{r.result}, #{r.reasonCd}, #{r.bookJson}::jsonb, #{r.scannedAt}, #{r.workerId}, #{r.clientReqId}, #{r.by})
mapper.update: update wms_loc_check c set status = 'DONE', done_at = now(), done_by = #{by}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by}, row_ver = c.row_ver + 1, ok_cnt = x.ok, misplaced_cnt = x.mis, missing_cnt = x.miss, unknown_cnt = x.unk, accurate_yn = case when x.mis + x.miss + x.unk = 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end from (select count(*) filter (where result = 'OK') as ok, count(*) filter (where result = 'MISPLACED') as mis, count(*) filter (where result = 'MISSING') as miss, count(*) filter (where result = 'UNKNOWN') as unk from wms_loc_check_line where check_id = #{id}) x where c.check_id = #{id} and c.status = 'OPEN'

update wms_loc_check_line set review_action = #{action}, review_reason = #{reason}, reviewed_at = now(), reviewed_by = #{by}, move_grp_id = #{grp}::uuid where line_id = #{lineId} and review_action is null
mapper.select:
select * from (select ) x order by
x.path x.status x.open_cnt x.check_date
desc,
x.check_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select c.check_id, c.plant_cd, c.check_date, wms_node_path(c.node_id) as path, l.result, i.item_cd, m.lot_no from wms_loc_check_line l join wms_loc_check c on c.check_id = l.check_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join lot_master m on m.lot_id = l.lot_id where l.result <> 'OK' and l.review_action is null and c.plant_cd = #{plantCd} order by c.check_date, l.line_id limit #{limit}
select coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') from mst_equip_hier n left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.node_id = #{nodeId} and n.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
